stem: A learner is comparing two cannabis plants at different developmental stages. Which observation is most useful for distinguishing vegetative growth from reproductive development?
choices: The presence and development of reproductive floral structures at the nodes and shoot tips
The color of the container holding the root zone
The commercial name assigned to the cultivar
The brand of irrigation equipment used
rationale: Developmental stage is identified from plant morphology and reproductive development, not equipment, cultivar branding, or container appearance.
